title: Hong Kong Bourse May Add To Its Winnings
text:
Hong Kong Bourse May Add To Its Winnings January 30, 2019, 08:00:00 Hong Kong stock market rebounded on Wednesday, one session after it had snapped the four-day winning streak in which it had advanced more than 570 points or 2.3 percent. The Hang Seng Index now rests just above the 27,640-point plateau and it's expected extend its gains on Hang Seng finished modestly higher on Wednesday as gains from the financials and oil companies were capped by weakness from the casinos - while the properties and insurance companies were mixed.
For the day, the index climbed 111.17 points or 0.40 percent to finish at the daily high of 27,642.85 after moving as low as 27,369.75.
Among the actives, China Resources Land surged 3.56 percent, while China Petroleum and Chemical (Sinopec) soared 2.49 percent, China Mengniu Dairy spiked 2.25 percent, AAC Technologies plummeted 2.04 percent, China Life Insurance plunged 1.87 percent, Sino Land tumbled 1.28 percent, CNOOC jumped 1.27 percent, New World Development climbed 1.18 percent, WH Group skidded 1.17 percent, China Mobile advanced 0.67 percent, Ping An Insurance added 0.61 percent, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China collected 0.50 percent, CITIC shed 0.34 percent, AIA Group gained 0.29 percent, Sands China lost 0.27 percent, Hong Kong & China Gas fell 0.27 percent, Galaxy Entertainment eased 0.10 percent and BOC Hong Kong and CSPC Pharmaceutical were unchanged.
 (AAPL).
